title: Christophersen's problem for monomial algebras
summary: Christophersen's problem predicts that the connected component of the automorphism group of a finite-dimensional local algebra $A$ of dimension $\ell$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero has dimension at least $\ell-1$, with equality if and only if $A$ is isomorphic to $\mathbf{k}[t]/(t^{\ell})$. We settle this problem in the class of monomial algebras. Using the combinatorial structure of the irredundant irreducible decomposition of a monomial ideal, we prove the predicted inequality and characterize the equality case.
